class.name: MidiStreamPlayback
class.brief_description: Playback side of [MidiStream]: SoundFont synthesis plus live note triggering.
class.description: Obtained from an [AudioStreamPlayer]'s [method AudioStreamPlayer.get_stream_playback] when playing a [MidiStream]. Besides rendering the MIDI file through the SoundFont synthesizer, it allows triggering notes live (independent of the file's events) for gameplay-driven music or effects. [b]Note:[/b] The [param preset_index] arguments refer to the preset index inside the loaded SoundFont (as listed in its preset table), not the General MIDI program number.

method.name: note_on
method.description: Triggers a note using the given SoundFont preset index, MIDI key (0-127), and velocity (0.0-1.0).
